watch.en: Fold gently: first about a quarter of the foam into the mixture, then the rest, until blended.
watch.de: Behutsam unterheben: zuerst etwa ein Viertel des Schaums in die Masse, dann den Rest, bis alles vermengt ist.

why.en: Folding mixes the foam in without breaking it down.
why.de: Unterheben mischt den Schaum ein, ohne ihn zusammenfallen zu lassen.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 9.1 Introduction to Egg White Foams, section Egg White Foams
sources.sentence: Folding is a gentle mixing step that allows egg white foam to be incorporated into recipes without breaking down the foam

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 9.3 Foam Products - Souffles, cheese souffle recipe
sources.sentence: Fold about one-fourth of the foam into the cheese mixture; spread the cheese mixture over the remaining egg white foam
